primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: The primary endpoint of this study was the mean fold titer increase from baseline to Day 18 in circulating serum anti-RSV neutralizing antibody following treatment with RI-001.

groups.description: Dose regimen 1 (High Dose): RI-001 1,500 mg/kg dose on day 1, and 750 mg/kg dose on day 3.
groups.title: 1 (High Dose)

groups.description: Dose regimen 2 (Low Dose): RI-001 750 mg/kg dose on day 1, and 750 mg/kg dose on day 3.
groups.title: 2 (Low Dose)

groups.description: Placebo (Normal saline): 7.5 mL/kg or 15 mL/kg dose on day 1, and 7.5 mL/kg dose on day 2.
groups.title: 3 (Placebo)

primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Circulating RI-001 Titer
